sources.title: Model Card for Cohere Labs Command A Translate
sources.evidence: Exact dated model card identifies Cohere and Cohere Labs, an open-weight research release with nominal 111B parameters, 8k input and 8k output, and CC-BY-NC-4.0 with the Cohere Labs Acceptable Use Policy. Weight files require accepting the repository terms.

sources.title: Announcing Cohere’s Command A Translate Model
sources.evidence: Explicit August 28, 2025 release announcement identifies command-a-translate-08-2025, 23-language translation, 111 billion parameters and 16K combined input/output length.

sources.title: Cohere’s Command A Translate Model
sources.evidence: Exact model API documentation lists Context Window 8,000 and Max Output Tokens 8,000; prose describes 16K combined as 8K input plus 8K output. Text translation examples are provided. Rendered Reasoning badge is disabled and Tool Use is enabled; the underlying first-party source and renderer were also inspected.

sources.title: Command-A-Translate: Raising the Bar of Machine Translation with Difficulty Filtering
sources.evidence: Later November 2025 technical paper sections 2.1 and 2.5 identify the released exact checkpoint, its Command A lineage, a 111B dense decoder-only Transformer, and DPO fine-tuning. The separate two-model CommandA-WMT system must not be confused with this single model. No separately defined active-parameter count is reported.

sources.title: Explore our models — Command A Translate
sources.evidence: Command A Translate entry explicitly advertises 23 languages, localization workflows, downloadable weights, tool use and structured outputs, and CC-BY-NC-4.0.

sources.title: Official Command A Translate documentation source
sources.evidence: Exact model showcase includes ToolUse among enabled capabilities and excludes Reasoning. Sets contextWindow and maxOutputTokens to 8,000. The renderer gives the absent Reasoning capability an explicit disabled state.

sources.title: Official model showcase capability renderer
sources.evidence: getCapabilities sets each named capability disabled when it is not in enabledCapabilities. Disabled badges have a slash icon and reduced opacity. Together with the exact model source this verifies the explicit negative reasoning badge, rather than relying on prose omission.

sources.title: CC-BY-NC 4.0 license agreement
sources.evidence: License agreement linked by the exact model card identifies the Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 terms.

sources.title: Baseline Hugging Face link with c4ai prefix
sources.evidence: The baseline URL returned 401 during this audit. The accessible first-party model card uses command-a-translate-08-2025 without c4ai-.

sources.title: Checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: Direct file access returned 401 because repository files are gated; no access terms were accepted and no exact learned tensor count was derived.

name.note: Exact public name; the dated identifier is unchanged.

developer.note: Card credits Cohere and its Cohere Labs research organization.

family.note: The exact translation checkpoint is DPO fine-tuned from Command A.

release_date.note: First-party dated announcement explicitly says the exact API identifier is available immediately.

open_weights.note: Official research weights are published, with access subject to accepting terms.

license.note: Weights use CC-BY-NC-4.0 and require the linked acceptable-use policy; this is not an unrestricted commercial license.

parameters_b.note: Published whole-model nominal count in billions, not an exact independently counted learned-parameter total. Gated files prevented tensor-header inspection.

active_parameters_b.note: A separately defined active-parameter count is not reported. Dense architecture does not justify copying the total into this field.

architecture.note: Section 2.1 establishes the dense decoder-only Transformer backbone; section 2.5 describes DPO fine-tuning for this released model. The multi-model WMT competition system is separate.

context_window.note: Retain the explicitly labeled API Context Window/input budget of 8,000. The same docs describe 16K combined as 8K input plus 8K maximum output; the record must not imply 8K combined.

modalities.note: Exact model card and API examples describe text input and text translation output.

reasoning.note: The exact API capability matrix explicitly renders Reasoning disabled. This means no advertised dedicated reasoning mode; it is not a claim that the model cannot perform ordinary reasoning or multi-stage prompted translation.

tool_call.note: Tool use is explicitly enabled in the exact-model documentation and advertised in Cohere’s model overview.

description.value: Translation model for multilingual conversion, localization, and cross-language workflows
description.note: The baseline use-case description is supported by Cohere’s translation and localization documentation.

patch.notes: 111B is the developer’s nominal whole-model parameter count; active parameters are not separately disclosed. Architecture is a dense decoder-only Transformer fine-tuned from Command A. The API lists 8,000 input/context tokens and 8,000 maximum output tokens, also described as 16K combined. Research weights use CC-BY-NC-4.0 with Cohere Labs acceptable-use conditions. Reasoning=false refers to the explicitly disabled dedicated reasoning capability; the separate CommandA-WMT and Deep Translation workflows do not change this model specification.

summary: Confirmed the exact August 28, 2025 release and existing text, context, tool-use and dedicated-reasoning flags. Added nominal 111B parameters, dense architecture and CC-BY-NC-4.0 license from current primary sources and the later first-party technical paper. Replaced catalog-only source provenance with primary evidence and supplied the working official weight URL. Active parameters remain undisclosed; the 8K input plus 8K output distinction is documented. Gated configuration access did not establish an exact learned tensor count.
